scope: Top-level events 49–58 in current EVENTS order; second-pass official-source and route/GPX audit

policy.historicalGpx: Existing GPX files remain valid until a new official file is released, downloaded and validated. Never delete or replace a historical file merely because a new edition is announced.
policy.binaryValidation: External GPX binaries were not downloaded and parsed in this package. Official download/map availability is recorded separately from binary validation.
policy.appChanges: Audit-only checkpoint; no app route data or GPX files changed.

events.name: Zugspitz Ultratrail by UTMB
events.finding: All seven official 2027 races and metrics confirmed. ZUT100 is 167 km / 8,205 m+, not simply '100 miles' as a precise distance. Official race pages expose Map + GPX sections, but direct download URLs were not extracted in this package.
events.followUp: Reconcile all seven app entries to these official metrics and export/validate GPX from each official race map.

events.name: Schluchthof Backyard
events.finding: The official Schluchthof site now explicitly says 'Schluchthof Backyard 2027 ist in der Planung'. No date, loop metrics or GPX are published in the current notice. The earlier 502 access failure is therefore superseded for event-existence status, but not for route details.
events.followUp: Keep event in planning status; recheck for date, loop length/elevation and official GPX once organizer publishes details.

events.name: Tschirgant Sky
events.finding: The prior official checkpoint confirms four distances for 12 June 2027. App currently only lists TS52 Ultra, so three route records are missing. No official GPX download was confirmed in the current audit.
events.followUp: Add/check all four official distance records and request the 2027 GPX files from the organizer.

events.name: La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB
events.finding: Official 2027 inventory and route metrics confirmed for all five distances. Current race pages include GPX track sections. The direct links previously found in app data are dated 2024, 2025 or 2026; none should be relabelled as a 2027 file. New direct file URLs were not extracted in this package.
events.followUp: Keep old GPX files as historical/current fallback until new official 2027 files are downloaded and parsed; export each 2027 track from its official page when available.
